samples.notes: UNESCO Courier Jan-Mar 2026, 8-page excerpt (merges former basic-en and passage-en fixtures; issue pp. 4-6, 9, 12-13, 38 plus the contents page). PDF p1: contents grid with dotted page leaders, section headers, sharing the page with the editorial (Agnes Bardon). p2: article opener, oversized italic display title, author rail with bio, large embroidered-photo artwork. p3: display-title continuation with near-full-page artwork and rotated credit rail. p4: drop cap, two/three-column body, centered pull quote, boxed sidebar (LINKS programme). p5: article opener with standfirst, author rail, bottom photo with caption. p6: three-column body (IDEAS), boxed feature (2025 quantum year), left-rail pull quote, right-edge full-height illustration. p7: article opener with drop cap, three-column body, bottom pull quote, two-author sidebar rail. p8: top full-width photo with caption and right pull quote, three-column body, end-of-article marker.

Vogue (US) Winter 2025, 3-page excerpt. p1: FENDI full-page advertisement (photo, brand wordmark, vertical rail with boutique contact). p2: OMEGA full-page advertisement (product photo, tagline, body blurb, brand mark; vertical rail with URL). p3: contents page - masthead wordmark, issue date, hero photo with caption block, multi-column TOC grid with page numbers and blurbs, 'Cover Look' boxed sidebar with two cover thumbnails, bottom folio (p.22), vertical credits rail.

CERN Courier Jul-Aug 2026 (Vol 66 No 4), digital-edition excerpt. CAUTION: digital edition is paginated as landscape TWO-PAGE SPREADS with a persistent navigation chrome bar (masthead + icon buttons) along the bottom of every PDF page; print typography is otherwise preserved. p1 spread: front cover (masthead, cover lines, full-bleed photo) + welcome/editorial column. p2 spread: full-page conference advertisement (IBIC 2026) + 'In This Issue' contents (department grid, article thumbnails with blurbs and page numbers). p3 spread: full-page vendor advertisement (Bergoz) + News Analysis page (dense single-story news layout, margin pull quote, photo with caption). p4 spread: feature spread 'Culture and History' pp. 24-25 (three-column dense body, multiple captioned photos, right-rail pull quote). Technical/trade-magazine density pole of the corpus; real commercial ads.

IMF Finance & Development, June 2026 (Vol 63 No 2), English edition excerpt. p1: front cover (large wordmark, cover-line strip with three teasers, full-bleed collage art). p2: full-page house advertisement (World Economic Outlook). p3: contents page - two-section TOC grid with page numbers, large red pull quote inline, bottom image with page cross-reference. p4: full-page house advertisement (IMF Weekend Read, photo with QR code). p5: masthead page - staff/colophon column plus multilingual-editions promo panel (seven language covers). p6: 'Kaleidoscope' news-brief page (big picture photo with caption box, three-column brief with oversized headline). p7: 'Point of View' opener (full-column illustration, drop cap, author photo, standfirst). p8: 'Currency Notes' back-of-book article (oversized headline, single image with typewriter-style margin caption, two-column body, author sign-off). NOTE: official Chinese edition exists for this issue; pair FD-zh to promote this entry to translation_eval.

AramcoWorld Jul-Aug 2026 (Vol 77 No 4), 8-page excerpt. p1: front cover (wordmark over full-bleed geometric dome photo, minimal cover lines). p2: masthead/colophon page - narrow staff and subscription column, right half full-height photo. p3: contents page - FEATURES entries with oversized page numerals and thumbnail images, DEPARTMENTS strip, front-cover description box, rotated credit rail. p4: feature page (p30) - large photo top, two-column body, oversized centered pull quote with attribution, narrow margin caption column. p5: feature opener (p33) - giant ghosted display type 'RAILWAY?', large-leading standfirst, two-column body, margin captions, embedded photo. p6: feature body (p34) - boxed section heading, two stacked photos left column, margin caption, two-column body. p7: Reviews (p40) - book-review layout with cover thumbnails, italic pull-quote panel, footer motto line. p8: Reviews (p41) - asymmetric three-column review layout, artwork image top-left, book thumbnail, shaded pull-quote panel, rotated credit rail. Photo-led feature-magazine pole of the corpus.
